intro: Brotherhood of Thieves is an early task assigned by Deputy Willem outside Northshire Abbey. It directs young Alliance recruits across the eastern river to push back an encroaching band of brigands known as the Defias Brotherhood. Collecting the thieves' signature red burlap bandanas provides Stormwind authorities their first tangible evidence of the group's organized presence in the valley.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire. They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.
I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good! Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Back with some bandanas, I see. The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
